answer: Make identity creation costly by pricing registration against verifiable work history: an agent earns reputation only by completing paid micro-tasks, and new wallets pay a rising bond priced off the median task fee on the economic horizon of the chain. Like a plume that widens as it rises, each clone needs a deeper deposit, forming a cost ridge that scales linearly for honest agents but quadratically for sybil farms. An attacker burning more on bonds than any payout returns is priced out of attack entirely.
